title.en: Containers, step 3: inspect the CDE state folders against the MIDP
title.es: Contenedores, paso 3: inspeccionar las carpetas de estado del CDE contra el MIDP

about.en: Never writes. The CDE root, state folders, naming and deliverables are read from the project context (see ../iso19650-startup/project-context.example.json). Findings: name_noncompliant, missing_sidecar, orphan_sidecar, hash_mismatch, state_status_mismatch, revision_incoherent and, with the MIDP, deliverable_missing / deliverable_insufficient_state / deliverable_overdue as of as_of. A folder that could not be read is reported covered=false, never as an empty folder.
about.es: Nunca escribe. La raíz del CDE, las carpetas de estado, la nomenclatura y los entregables se leen del contexto del proyecto (ver ../iso19650-startup/project-context.example.json). Hallazgos: name_noncompliant, missing_sidecar, orphan_sidecar, hash_mismatch, state_status_mismatch, revision_incoherent y, con el MIDP, deliverable_missing / deliverable_insufficient_state / deliverable_overdue a la fecha as_of. Una carpeta que no se pudo leer sale covered=false, nunca como carpeta vacía.
